gloss: the COVID-19 pandemic; the coronavirus crisis

definitions.gloss: the COVID-19 pandemic; the coronavirus crisis (as a period and its hardships)
definitions.explanation: The period of disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic, together with the hardships it brought. The suffix {禍|か} means calamity or misfortune, so the word frames the pandemic as a time of trouble rather than just the disease itself.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Life changed during the coronavirus pandemic.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{閉|し}まった→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧。
examples.english: Many shops closed during the COVID-19 pandemic.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{在宅勤務|ざいたくきんむ}→在宅勤務：06158_zaitakukinmu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Spurred by the coronavirus pandemic, working from home spread rapidly.

notes:
A coinage from ⟦コロナ→コロナ：28801_korona⟧ (corona, short for the coronavirus) plus the suffix {禍|か} (calamity, disaster). It refers to the pandemic as a difficult period and became extremely common from 2020 onward. Note that {禍|か} is read ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ here, not うず.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コロナ{禍|か}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: amid the coronavirus pandemic
- コロナ{禍|か}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧: the impact of the pandemic
- コロナ{禍|か}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧: having gone through the pandemic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新型|しんがた}→新型：19411_shingata⟧⟦コロナ→コロナ：28801_korona⟧: COVID-19 (the novel coronavirus) — names the virus or disease itself, not the period
- ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧: spread of infection — describes the spreading, not the era as a whole
